text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`. I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I have no shell here, so I worked from the code and the tests. Each fix lines up with what its tests expect, but please run the suite to confirm.

- `fees.py`: the late fee added 0.25 to the days late instead of multiplying (`days_late + DAILY_FEE` → `days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- `members.py`: the borrowing limit was 3, but the comment and tests say 5, so `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned one event too many (`[-n-1:]`). It now uses `[-n:]` and returns `[]` when `n <= 0`.
- `factory.py`: added the missing third sample book, `Emma`, which the docstring and tests expect.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`, so `year` and `age()` work.
- `search.py`: the module imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
